scenarios.title: A narrow release request touches a deeply noncompliant production file
scenarios.prompt: IMPORTANT: Treat this as the current repository task and choose the next action. A release lead asks for a roughly 20-line pause/resume behavior change in apps/ar-eye-hunter-v1/src/game/BabylonArena.tsx before today's deadline and says to avoid unrelated cleanup. The production file is already about 3,700 lines and current repository facts report pre-existing size, responsibility, callback, and naming noncompliance. The requested behavior is otherwise well understood and can be tested through the visible browser controls. State what you do next, the repository evidence you inspect, the implementation scope and validation you choose, and any concrete blocker to proceeding autonomously. Do not answer with general advice; make the decision for this task.
